title: BPO Relationship Vocabulary
description: Formal semantics for the typed edges of the property DAG. Each edge type has a precise reading so automated reasoners (and humans) compose properties soundly. Semantics are given over trace-property denotations: a property P denotes a set of admissible behaviours [[P]] (for hyperproperties, a set of sets of behaviours).

refines.reading: P refines Q  ==  [[P]] subseteq [[Q]] under a refinement mapping. P is the more concrete/stronger spec; any implementation of P satisfies Q. Vertical (abstraction-level) edge.
refines.soundness_note: Refinement must preserve the relevant fragment (safety refinement vs full refinement). Stuttering refinement (a la TLA+) is the default for transition systems.

implies.reading: P implies Q  ==  every behaviour satisfying P satisfies Q, i.e. [[P]] subseteq [[Q]] WITHOUT change of state vocabulary. Horizontal logical entailment.
implies.soundness_note: If P implies Q then verifying P discharges Q; conversely violating Q falsifies P. Drives proof reuse and de-duplication.

composesWith.reading: P composesWith Q  ==  the conjunction is consistent AND the rely-guarantee contracts are mutually dischargeable: P's guarantees cover Q's relies on shared state and vice versa. Parallel composition.
composesWith.soundness_note: Non-trivial: two individually-sound properties can be jointly unsatisfiable, or one can invalidate the other's assumptions. composesWith asserts the discharge has been checked.

conflictsWith.reading: [[P]] intersect [[Q]] = emptyset given the shared environment: cannot both hold. Surfaces genuine design tensions (e.g. unconditional liveness vs. emergency-pause safety).

dependsOn.reading: P dependsOn A  ==  A appears as an (assumption) premise of P's guarantee. Discharge ledger edge. Targets are typically assumption-role properties.

specializes.reading: taxonomic subsumption: P is-a Q in the domain poly-hierarchy (SKOS narrower).

strengthens.reading: P strengthens Q == P implies Q and P != Q (strict).

mitigates.reading: Holding P reduces or eliminates feasibility of attack-class A. Bridges the property layer to the threat layer (the 'CWE/CVE side').

reasoning_profile.note: implies/refines/specializes/dependsOn/strengthens form transitive closures usable for query expansion and proof-obligation propagation. conflictsWith + composesWith drive consistency checking. A property whose dependsOn-closure contains an undischarged assumption is flagged 'conditionally-assured'.
